method: rg -F over named roots with excludes: .git, node_modules, .venv, graft, __pycache__, dist; docs/archive/ excluded per brief; LICENSE and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES excluded from leak judgment (legal). frontend/qubit-dist included on purpose (served bundle).

summaries.legal_provenance: LICENSE/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES and the generated manifests' upstream_repo/upstream_license fields. Must not be changed.
summaries.required_compat_identifiers: Wire/protocol, env, DB, and registry ids. Renaming them without an adapter breaks the served SPA, existing installs, or persisted state.
summaries.migration_only_aliases: Read-old/write-new fallbacks and legacy home/name adoption. Safe to retire after a migration window.
summaries.test_fixture_history: tests/**, docs/generated ledgers, parity artifacts, sample sessions. Not shipped product surfaces.
summaries.unapproved_public_leaks: Actionable: user-visible/served/repo-advertised legacy strings that are Qubit-owned and safe (or adapter-backed) to de-brand.

safe_to_rename_now.why_safe: Qubit-owned bundled plugin (source: 'bundled'). Its route literal /api/plugins/hermes-achievements/* is a compat alias that can be served alongside a Qubit-canonical /api/plugins/achievements/* until the plugin and its state are migrated.

Stored inside QUBIT_HOME. Rename to a Qubit name with read-old fallback; the importer already treats it as a read-only source.
